name: Revisely
subtitle: Even one verse counts
promotionalText: Even one verse counts. A little revision every day across everything you've memorised, with Revo to help you keep going.
description:
Even one verse counts. Revisely builds a daily revision schedule over exactly what you know, and keeps it going even when you miss a day. Free, with no ads.
• Revise page by page, even offline
• Time and record your recitation, or listen with a reciter
• Revo, an optional AI coach that knows your progress
• Activity calendar, insights and streaks
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen: today's revision, the next prayer and the Qibla

whatsNew.feature: Recite from memory and see your mistakes as you go: turn on Mark mistakes in the reader.
